basic_details.job_title: SNDT Assistant Registrar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: SNDT Women's University has invited applications for 01 Assistant Registrar post to be filled on purely contractual basis for 06 months on fixed honorarium at the Churchgate Campus of the University. Interested and eligible candidates must send their applications by email to [email protected] till 10.00 am on the day of the interview. The walk-in interview will be held on 19-11-2026 at 11.00 am at S.N.D.T. Women's University, Mumbai 400 020.

age_limit.details: Not less than 18 years of age and not more than 38 years age in case of person belonging to General Category and not more than 43 years of age in case of persons belonging to Backward Classes.

qualification.details: Who possess a degree of any Recognized Statutory University. Knowledge of Computer is essential. Knowledge of Marathi & English Languages essential. Who has administrative experience of not less than five years in a similar capacity. (similar capacity means experience in equivalent or at least near equivalent post either within the organization or outside.) | Not less than 18 years of age and not more than 38 years age in case of person belonging to General Category and not more than 43 years of age in case of persons belonging to Backward Classes.

content_sections.heading: About SNDT Assistant Registrar
content_sections.text: SNDT Women's University, 1, Nathibai Thackersey Road, Mumbai 400 020, operates its academic and administrative functions across its campuses, including the Churchgate Campus. This recruitment drive aims to fill an administrative position on a contractual basis for a duration of six months to support university operations.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications for the said post will be accepted on the email ID [email protected] till 10.00 am on the day of interview. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Who possess a degree of any Recognized Statutory University. Knowledge of Computer is essential. Knowledge of Marathi & English Languages essential. Who has administrative experience of not less than five years in a similar capacity. (similar capacity means experience in equivalent or at least near equivalent post either within the organization or outside.) Not less than 18 years of age and not more than 38 years age in case of person belonging to General Category and not more than 43 years of age in case of persons belonging to Backward Classes.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under SNDT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Assistant Registrar post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email till 10.00 am on the day of the interview, which is 19-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for SNDT Assistant Registrar?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree from any recognized statutory university, along with essential knowledge of computers, Marathi, and English languages, plus not less than five years of administrative experience in a similar capacity.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for General Category candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the General Category must not be less than 18 years of age and not more than 38 years age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Backward Classes candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to Backward Classes must not be more than 43 years of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly honorarium for the Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 55,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their application to the email ID [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at S.N.D.T. Women's University, Mumbai 400 020.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The post is filled purely on a contractual basis for 06 months on fixed honorarium.
